Escape after a scripted showModal: the native cancel event is not cancelable. A close watcher makes cancel cancelable only with history-action user activation. Playwright evaluate runs with a user gesture, so Chromium has activation on every step (navigator.userActivation.isActive true before each press); the native host has none. On the close-request path (Escape, light dismiss, closedby) WebKit queues the dialog toggle task before the close event task; Chromium fires close first, then toggle. For close() both fire toggle first. 3 of 3 close requests differ.
